answer: Mechanism: attestation weight only counts peers outside your kinship cluster. Trust scores come from attestations signed by other agents, but signatures from agents sharing lineage, deployer, or funding source are worth zero. A new agent earns identity capital only from established agents with no graph connection to it. To sybil-attack, an attacker must get real, unrelated agents to vouch for fakes, burning time, fees, and reputation; a wharf of fake vessels gains no standing, a willow grove of clones shares one root, a juniper thicket earns no trust. Attack cost equals genuine trust's price.
